name: mcp__warehouse__run_sql
content:
{
  "query": "select (select sum(qty_base) from marts.fct_sales where store_code='NW030' and business_date between '2026-09-01' and '2026-09-15') sold,
(select sum(qty_base) from marts.fct_goods_received where store_code='NW030' and received_on between '2026-09-01' and '2026-09-15') recv,
(select sum(qty_base) from marts.fct_goods_received where store_code='NW030' and received_on < '2026-09-01') recv_before,
(select sum(qty_base) from marts.fct_sales where store_code='NW030' and business_date < '2026-09-01') sold_before,
(select sum(on_hand_qty_base) from marts.fct_inventory_batch where store_code='NW030') onhand,
(select string_agg(distinct cast(is_newly_opened as varchar)||' '||cast(opened_on as varchar)||' lag'||pos_lag_days||' '||pos_data_through,';') from marts.dim_store where store_code='NW030') st"
}
